themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers research and development related to AI agents that can perform tasks autonomously, make decisions, and interact with systems or users.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and research that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for easier understanding and analysis.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Explores how AI tools and techniques are used to analyze complex datasets, uncover insights, and inform decision-making.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly support or enhance the design and user research process, from ideation to synthesis.

themes.name: AI research platforms
themes.description: Articles focusing on platforms and tools specifically built to facilitate or automate aspects of research using AI.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the findings, implications, and user experiences related to AI-powered chatbots, including their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback
themes.description: Focuses on how AI analyzes and interprets user sentiment, feedback, and reviews to extract actionable insights.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and evaluate different AI tools and platforms for research purposes, highlighting their features and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses the effects of AI on jobs, skills, recruitment, and the broader labor market.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
